{{Top|leg}}
'''Harpoons''' were hand-held throwing weapons used by the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]. The harpoons could be used in combat, or as a device to subdue and reel in targets if they were attached to a line. All Wind Raiders carried a harpoon as their primary weapon.
